title: Search-Budget Artifacts in Continuous Causal Emergence: replication package
description:
Replication package for the paper Search-Budget Artifacts in Continuous Causal Emergence: Fixed-Step Riemannian Optimization Manufactures Apparent Scale Dependence. Contains the estimator code, one runner script per result, the data-retrieval script for the industry portfolio returns, the four figures, the REVTeX manuscript source, and a Lean 4 formalization of the closure defect and of the Rayleigh-Ritz step of Proposition 1.

The industry portfolio returns are not redistributed; they are retrieved from the Kenneth R. French Data Library and verified by SHA-256 against the file used in the paper.
